title: Implement the positive rank-one native C tensor leaf with complete literal control and retained workspace accounting
body:
## Exact scoped result
A 29-tape graph implements every tensor axis of the selected positive C leaf with complete fV cost and atomic public commit. Independent proof and execution checks passed. Every intermediate prefix must be integral and fit signed range. Credits #3091 and #7000.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/1a555e469b89af70d309bc966f8f813ac11dc887/research/literal-positive-c-leaf
